scenarios.title: Edit and save every editable task field
evidence: The inline editor accepted changes to title, notes, category, priority, and due date.
Saving closed the editor and rendered every updated value in the task list.

scenarios.title: A task cannot be saved without a title
evidence: Whitespace-only title kept the inline editor open.
The editor showed "Title is required." and browser storage retained the original title.

scenarios.title: Cancel discards task edits
evidence: The task retained its original title.

scenarios.title: Saved task edits persist after reload
evidence: Reloading retained the edited task title and notes in the UI.
Browser storage retained the edited category, priority, and due date.

scenarios.title: Existing completion and deletion actions still work
evidence: An active task could still be completed.
A different task could still be deleted.
